meaning: Open limit: main thermal limit, flame rollout switch, or reverse airflow switch.
causes: External static pressure above nameplate (duct issues)
Heat rise out of specification or outlet gas pressure out of specification
Restricted flue piping or wrong LP orifices (rollout)
diySteps: Turn off power and make sure the filter is clean
Technician: check blower, static pressure, heat rise and gas pressure
Technician: for rollout, check flue, orifices, burners and heat exchanger before resetting rollout switches
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician: if the code returns after a filter change, or a rollout switch has tripped.
